notes.title: Shinobi Saga Out Now
notes.content: The full game has been released, hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Shinobi Saga is Participating in the Pirates vs. Ninjas Festival
notes.content: I've released some updates to the demo in anticipation for Shinobi Saga's participation in the Pirates vs. Ninjas festival. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: The Shinobi Saga Demo is Live
notes.content: Inspired by games like Superstar Saga and Paper Mario, Shinobi Saga takes an interactive approach to combat and wraps it in a replayable, ninja-themed format. I'm happy to announce that the demo for the game is now live and you can play for free through the first zone. Hope you enjoy!
